_meta.purpose: Maps Laya's tier / pii_gate output (integrations/laya/laya_route.py) to a concrete route.
_meta.mirrors: CLAUDE.md's model-tiering table and integrations/omniroute/README.md's routing map, 2026-09-28.
_meta.rule: Change CLAUDE.md's tiering table first, then integrations/omniroute/README.md, then this file to match. Never the other way.
_meta.invariant: pii_gate=true always overrides tier, with no exception. A client-shaped request never reaches the research or subscription routes, whatever tier Laya also guessed.
_meta.note: Route/tier NAMES only, never model names, per CLAUDE.md's naming rule — this file and laya_route.py's output are things Steven (or a log) can grep.

true.note: Overrides tier unconditionally, whatever brain_route/tier said. No cloud fallback, ever: if the local combo can't be reached, the request DEFERS (claude-auto.sh exit 75) — it never reroutes to subscription, free-fallback or the research combo. See integrations/omniroute/README.md #hard-rules.

orchestrator.note: Vanessa only — orchestration/council chair/final synthesis. Plain `claude`, OAuth, no proxy env. Never through OmniRoute (see integrations/omniroute/README.md #hard-rules).

executive.note: A C-suite lane owns this outright. Plain `claude`, OAuth, no proxy env. Never through OmniRoute.

worker.note: Report/bench/execution-only seat. Plain `claude`, OAuth, no proxy env. Never through OmniRoute.

research.seat_tier: n/a — Perplexity is a product, not a Claude tier
research.note: Research heavy lifting, per CLAUDE.md sub-agent dispatch cap (≤4 Perplexity per wave). Deferred (never called) by this repo's own tooling — Perplexity calls happen only when an agent with that allowance actually runs one.

local.fallback: none by construction — a single-target combo, so OmniRoute itself has nothing else to fall back to (see integrations/omniroute/README.md §How the local combo fails closed)
local.provider_id_placeholder: set by setup-local-llm.sh / configure-omniroute.sh at install time — not a fixed value in this file
